snippet.title: I Am Plague - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Join the playtest through October, 19: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5131690/I_am_Plague

I Am Plague is a dark incremental roguelite with automatic combat and permanent progression. Lead a horde of rats, collect mutations, create powerful synergies, and devour your enemies as you climb 200+ floors of a vast underground fortress. Every death makes you stronger.

Join us on Discord → https://discord.gg/iamplaguegame
Follow on X → https://x.com/iamplaguegame
Watch on TikTok → https://tiktok.com/@iamplaguegame
Explore on Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/iamplaguegame
